Un joyau gâché par la fumée…
Apr 2026 • Friends
The restaurant offers an absolutely enchanting setting: refined decor, a cozy atmosphere, and a view that invites relaxation. It's the kind of place where you want to linger.

The food is decent, without being exceptional. The dishes are well-executed, with balanced flavors and generous portions – no complaints there.

But what an absolute scandal that they allow smoking inside! This is not only a blatant violation of Tunisian law, which strictly prohibits smoking in enclosed spaces (Law No. 2007-37 and subsequent decree), but above all, it's a criminal lack of respect for customers. Having smoke blown in your face while enjoying your meal is intolerable! An insult to everyone's health and comfort. Shame on them for this irresponsible negligence that completely ruins the experience.

In short, a beautiful place to avoid as long as this barbaric practice persists.

Not at the level
Nov 2023 • Couples
My experience was just average. I arrived with my wife at 7:50 p.m. a little more than half an hour in advance for our reservation at the restaurant. We said to ourselves, let's have a drink at the bar first, the bar was EMPTY, no people seated except waiters who they twiddle their thumbs and yet we are told that it is full and that it is either at the bar or nothing, because even if it is empty they do not want to touch their “mise en place” go and understand what that means. We went to have our drink at the restaurant, the service is better but not up to the level the waiter made sure twice that we were going to order food when we told him that we were going to start first with an aperitif before ordering food, the dinner was good nothing more, but what was disappointing was that we were often left with empty glasses and I had to systematically ask for more wine, I should have asked to keep the bottle on the table if I knew it was so painful to refill
In summary, this establishment offers premium prices but the service does not follow, I hope that a manager will read this message at least it will have helped
